headline: GSK adjusts Nucala list price ahead of biosimilar pressure
detail: GSK filed a list price update for Nucala in the US market, a defensive move ahead of anticipated biosimilar entrants in the severe asthma segment. Net pricing to payers held flat via increased rebate offers.

headline: Sun Pharma expands dermatology field force by 18%
detail: Sun Pharma added ~40 dermatology-focused reps in the US Midwest and Southeast, targeting community dermatology practices previously covered by generalist reps.

headline: Abbott files next-gen CGM sensor for FDA review
detail: Abbott submitted its FreeStyle Libre 4 sensor, featuring extended 21-day wear and integrated ketone tracking, for FDA 510(k) clearance.

headline: Novo Nordisk lowers cash-pay price for Ozempic in select US states
detail: In response to compounded-GLP1 competition, Novo Nordisk introduced a direct-to-consumer cash price tier roughly 30% below WAC in five states.

headline: GSK reports positive Phase III readout for Jemperli in endometrial cancer
detail: Topline data showed statistically significant PFS improvement in first-line combination therapy, positioning Jemperli for expanded label filing.

headline: Sun Pharma shifts Winlevi to preferred tier on two regional formularies
detail: Formulary win with two mid-size regional PBMs expected to reduce prior-authorization friction and improve new-to-brand share.

headline: Abbott restructures diabetes care commercial team around health-system accounts
detail: Reorg consolidates account management under a single health-system-facing team rather than product-line silos, aiming to accelerate integrated CGM+pump conversations.

headline: Novo Nordisk advances CagriSema into additional Phase III cardiovascular outcomes trial
detail: New trial arm expands the label ambition of CagriSema beyond weight management into CV risk reduction, a direct challenge to competitor obesity pipelines.

headline: GSK receives expanded age indication for Arexvy RSV vaccine
detail: FDA expanded approval to include adults 50-59 at increased risk, broadening the addressable patient population ahead of the fall vaccination season.

headline: Sun Pharma in-licenses early oncology asset from US biotech
detail: Deal brings a preclinical ADC (antibody-drug conjugate) program in-house, signaling Sun Pharma's push to build a specialty oncology pipeline beyond generics.

headline: Abbott secures expanded Medicare coverage for CGM in Type 2 non-insulin patients
detail: CMS coverage expansion opens a substantially larger addressable Medicare population for FreeStyle Libre outside the traditional insulin-dependent segment.

headline: Novo Nordisk adds primary care specialty force ahead of oral GLP-1 launch
detail: New 200-rep primary-care-focused team being built out in anticipation of the oral semaglutide launch, separate from the existing endocrinology force.

headline: GSK re-files Blenrep BLA after resolving prior clinical hold data gaps
detail: Re-submission includes updated overall survival data addressing FDA's earlier confirmatory trial concerns from the initial accelerated approval withdrawal.

headline: Sun Pharma initiates head-to-head trial of Ilumya vs. leading IL-23 competitor
detail: Comparative trial in moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis is designed to generate differentiation data ahead of contract renewal cycles with major PBMs.

headline: Abbott launches lower-cost CGM variant targeting Type 2 self-pay segment
detail: Libre Rio is a stripped-down, lower-price CGM aimed at the growing self-pay Type 2 diabetes population, a segment largely uninsured for CGM today.

headline: Novo Nordisk faces FTC inquiry over GLP-1 pricing and patent strategy
detail: Federal Trade Commission opened a preliminary inquiry into patent thicketing practices around injector device patents that may delay generic entry.

headline: GSK consolidates respiratory and immunology field teams
detail: Combined call plan aims to reduce cost-to-serve while maintaining share-of-voice against AstraZeneca's competing respiratory portfolio.

headline: Sun Pharma undercuts branded oncology support drug pricing by 40%
detail: Aggressive generic pricing on a widely used supportive-care oncology drug is pressuring branded competitors' net realized price in community oncology networks.

headline: Abbott receives FDA clearance for FreeStyle Libre 4 with ketone tracking
detail: Clearance positions Abbott ahead of Dexcom's next-generation sensor timeline, with commercial launch targeted for Q4.

headline: Novo Nordisk reports strong Phase II weight-loss data for oral candidate Amycretin
detail: Data showed weight loss competitive with injectable GLP-1s in an oral formulation, a potential disruptor to the current injectable-dominant obesity market.

headline: GSK builds dedicated gynecologic oncology key account team
detail: New 25-person specialist team targets top 150 US gynecologic oncology centers ahead of the anticipated endometrial cancer label expansion.
